actions: Completed the previously unresolved tau_p indices 0..16 from np.logspace(-3,3,100), using the official low-tau dt=tau_p*0.05 rule, N=30, K=100, six flips, Time=10, tau_x=1, T=0.01, 50 source-realizations per point and the predecessor seed policy.

Used an equation-order-equivalent float32 compiled collector to make the stiff sweep tractable, recording true endpoints, public last-above-threshold endpoints, convergence fractions, negative-p/NaN events and threshold recrossing; literal PyTorch spot-check at index 16 matched the compiled medians closely and independently verified zero negative-p/NaN events there.

Ran a discretization sensitivity control for indices 17..21 with dt=tau_p*0.05 instead of the public discontinuous dt=0.001; literal PyTorch reruns for indices 17..19 independently confirmed zero negative-p and zero NaN-perplexity events under the smaller dt.

stiff_tau_completion.interpretation: The official smaller-dt branch below tau_p=0.01 is numerically stable in this 850-trajectory audit: no post-Euler negativity, NaN perplexity or threshold recrossing appeared. The previously observed low-tau NaN defect is therefore localized to the public dt discontinuity just above 0.01 rather than being intrinsic to all fast-astrocyte settings. The filtered-list endpoint mismatch persists throughout the stiff region.

dt_discontinuity_sensitivity.scaled_dt_rule: dt=tau_p*0.05 for the sensitivity run, keeping the continuous equations and all other settings fixed
dt_discontinuity_sensitivity.interpretation: At indices 17..19, replacing public dt=0.001 by the same scaled rule used immediately below the 0.01 cutoff removed all negative-p and NaN-perplexity events while leaving the convergence fraction unchanged for each seed set. Public last-above-threshold medians moved materially, showing that the plotted low-tau observables are discretization-sensitive even when final retrieval success is similar.

quality_notes: The 17-point stiff summary comes from a compiled float32 reimplementation preserving the public update/observable order and exact source pattern/query seeds. Literal PyTorch spot-checking was used to guard against implementation drift; exact bitwise identity is not claimed.

The continuous-time model, fixed-point analysis and qualitative mechanism are not refuted by these numerical findings; the claim is restricted to the public Euler discretization and filtered observable collector.
exact_next_action: Implement and validate a positivity/simplex-preserving replicator sensitivity update (multiplicative/exponential step with renormalization, same continuous fitness and x dynamics) against the smaller-dt Euler control on indices 17..21, then sweep the full public tau_p grid with matched seeds to quantify curve-level dependence of true endpoint, convergence and public filtered observables on integration scheme. Separately extend the continuous scaled-dt Euler rule across the low/transition region to isolate the dt=0.01 branch discontinuity. After the numerical-sensitivity map is complete, resume matched instantaneous-softmax versus finite-tau_p tests across T and tau_x to search for a regime where slow routing itself has a statistically robust benefit.
